en.headline: John Lee meets Shenzhen Party chief Jin Lei; sides sign cooperation pacts
en.dek: The Chief Executive and the Shenzhen Municipal Committee secretary discussed deeper collaboration and witnessed the signing of memoranda covering finance, innovation and technology, and supporting mainland firms going…
body: Chief Executive John Lee met Shenzhen Municipal Committee secretary Jin Lei at Government House on Thursday to exchange views on deepening Hong Kong-Shenzhen cooperation.

Lee said the two cities had set up dedicated task forces in key areas and that the memoranda and agreements signed that day covered finance, innovation and technology, and services for mainland enterprises expanding overseas.

He highlighted progress on the Northern Metropolis, the ranking of the Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou innovation cluster as the world’s top for another year, and preparations for the smooth opening of the new Huanggang port after more than 100 system tests and drills.

zh.headline: 李家超晤深圳市委書記靳磊 見證簽署多份合作備忘錄
zh.dek: 行政長官與深圳市委書記在禮賓府會面，就深化港深合作交換意見，並共同見證涵蓋金融、創科及服務企業出海等範疇的合作備忘錄和協議簽署。
body: 行政長官李家超周四在禮賓府與深圳市委書記靳磊會面，就深化港深合作交流意見。
李家超表示，兩地已設立不同合作專班，今日簽署的備忘錄和協議涵蓋金融、創新科技、服務企業出海等多個範疇，推進雙方邁向更高水平合作。
他提到北部都會區建設全速推進、「深圳—香港—廣州」創新集群再度全球排名第一，以及皇崗口岸已完成逾100項系統測試和演練，為順暢開通做好準備。
